title: Recursive NAND coordinate equivalence
statement: For each natural number $k$, the composite of the depth-$2k$ binary-address coordinate equivalence and the inverse address correspondences between even binary addresses and quaternary addresses gives an equivalence from the coordinates indexed by $	ext{Fin}(2^{2k})$ to those indexed by $	ext{Fin}(4^k)$.
